name: open-gold-mobile
description: Capacitor iOS container for the Open Gold System remote web app.

scripts.ios:add: npm run config:write && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run config:write && npx cap sync ios && node ./scripts/apply-ios-http-config.mjs
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.doctor: npm run config:write && npx cap doctor
